title: ATE Precision When Rare Endpoint Events Consume the Recruitment Budget
banked_reason: The proposed deliverable requires executed width-1/1000 enclosures for both values at kappa=1/2 and an equality-or-strict-gap determination, but this node expressly leaves both outputs open and supplies only the transfer/certification framework and unexecuted setup.

The delivered theorems establish bidirectional resource-stopped policy transfer, convergence of both unrestricted minimax risks, finite-prior Bayes oracles, and computability, but leave both focal constants and the minimax feedback difference unresolved.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery derived resource-stopped policy transfer and an exhaustive finite-game evaluator, sharpened the focal transfer constant from 13 to 8, and verified cited minimax and Tonelli sources. The required executed width-0.001 enclosures and feedback-gap determination remained open; the decision referee and independent terminal-validity consult confirmed kernel substitution. No Lean formalization was reached; re-raising requires a compressed certified solver or an equality proof while preserving the original kernel.
tldr: A rare endpoint both reveals an event rate and consumes a substantial share of recruitment resources. We prove a resource-stopped marked-experiment comparison, an all-procedure value characterization, and a deterministic certificate framework for adaptive and unrestricted precommitted designs. Transfer has total variation allowance \(12/B\) generally and \(8/B\) at \(\kappa=1/2\); its squared-loss allowances are \(108/B\) and \(72/B\). The requested width-\(1/1000\) values at one-half have not been evaluated, and the feedback difference remains open over the full intensity square. The intended use is a specialist planning benchmark for two prespecified clinical strategies with rare expensive follow-up.
gap: Expected-pathway budget optimization in Morciano--Moerbeek \cite{MorcianoMoerbeek2021OptimalSMART} does not retain endpoint-generated recruitment closure. Kolnogorov\textquotesingle s counts-and-exposure recursion \cite{Kolnogorov2022PoissonBandit} concerns running income on a deterministic horizon. Neither supplies this all-estimator resource-stopped contrast value.
fill: The theorem package derives the experiment comparison and computes certified minimax values for adaptive and complete exogenous design classes, with a computable budget threshold linking each requested tolerance to original-record procedures at every eligible budget. Its open benchmark decides the feedback difference without fixing a least-favorable support.
